examples.label: Visits per day as bars
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-chart" site="Global" id="visits-chart" height="16rem" aria_label="Visits per day this week" option={%{"xAxis" => %{"type" => "category", "data" => ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}, "yAxis" => %{"type" => "value"}, "series" => [%{"type" => "bar", "data" => [12, 18, 9, 22, 16]}]}} />

examples.label: Sign-ups over a month as a line
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-chart" site="Global" id="signups-chart" height="16rem" aria_label="Sign-ups per week this month" option={%{"xAxis" => %{"type" => "category", "data" => ["Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4"]}, "yAxis" => %{"type" => "value"}, "series" => [%{"type" => "line", "smooth" => true, "data" => [40, 52, 47, 63]}]}} />
